info.name: Companion Creatures
info.description: Companion creature types from World of Warcraft (Andrey Kuzinskiy).
info.author: Andrey Kuzinskiy (book), converted by Kaya Acarbay

description.p: Aquatic companion creatures include fish, crabs, frogs, octopi, water birds, turtles, otters, and other water-dwelling creatures. Sometimes they float in a bubble of water near their owners.
Loyalty Gift. While you have a aquatic companion whose Loyalty Score is 10 or higher, you have the Blessing of the Aquatic Companion, which gives you a Swim Speed equal to your Speed.

Companion creatures are magically bound to a character. Summoning or dismissing a companion requires the Magic action, and a character can have only one companion summoned at a time. A companion creature can’t take actions and can’t be targeted by attacks; if it takes any damage, it is instantly dismissed or deactivated. When a character acquires a companion, its Loyalty Score equals the character’s Charisma modifier (minimum of 1) and can’t be higher than the character’s Charisma. It increases by 1d4 if the companion is treated particularly well, and decreases by 1 if it is dismissed or deactivated by taking damage. If a companion’s Loyalty Score reaches 10 or higher, it gives the character a small supernatural gift while present.

Beast companion creatures include natural animals that neither fly nor swim, including Tiny and Small beasts, as well as the young of larger creatures. (These beasts don’t age while kept as a companion.)

Loyalty Gift. While you have a beast companion whose Loyalty Score is 10 or higher, you have the Blessing of the Beast Companion, which gives you proficiency and Expertise in Animal Handling and Survival.

Dragonkin companion creatures include dragon whelplings—younger and smaller than the whelps described in chapter 7—as well as draconic animals native to the Dragon Isles.

Loyalty Gift. While you have a dragonkin companion whose Loyalty Score is 10 or higher, you have the Blessing of the Dragonkin Companion, which gives you Advantage on saving throws to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

Humanoid companion creatures include imps, kobolds, baby murlocs, and a range of other beings that can help you in ways that don’t involve combat.

Loyalty Gift. While you have a humanoid companion whose Loyalty Score is 10 or higher, you have the Blessing of the Humanoid Companion, which gives you proficiency and Expertise in the Persuasion skill.

Magic companion creatures include a variety of beings that are fundamentally magical, including tiny fragments of Old Gods or other powers, stray eyes or tentacles of otherworldly origin, oozes, creatures of the Void, ghostly spirits, and animated magical tomes.
Loyalty Gift. While you have a magic companion whose Loyalty Score is 10 or higher, you have the Blessing of the Magic Companion, which gives you proficiency and Expertise in the Arcana skill.

Mechanical companion creatures include clockwork or otherwise engineered creatures, ranging from mechanical chickens to diminutive replicas of the Burning Legion’s terrifying fel reaver constructs.

Loyalty Gift. While you have a mechanical companion whose Loyalty Score is 10 or higher, you have the Blessing of the Mechanical Companion, which allows you to roll 1d4 whenever you take Psychic damage and reduce the damage taken by the number rolled.
